叶玄机.anchor: a young Chinese man with short dark hair, calm steady gaze, dark teal cotton jacket
叶玄机.look: a young Chinese man around twenty-two, short straight black hair slightly damp, narrow calm eyes with a steady measuring gaze, thin lips pressed flat, clean-shaven, pale oval face, wearing a dark teal cotton jacket over a worn grey inner robe, a weathered wooden medicine box on his back, half a bronze bell hanging at his waist, rain-soaked collar

bio.personality: 话少、观察力强、不轻易示弱，遇事先看再动
bio.backstory: 师门遭难，独身南下寻访青囊残卷，一路靠看病糊口
bio.costume: 深青布衣，内衬灰旧中衣，背旧药箱，腰间悬半枚铜铃
bio.habits: 思考时摩挲药箱铜扣；被人看穿时会先沉默一息
bio.voice_style: 偏低、语速慢、少用语气词，紧张时句子更短

掌柜.anchor: an elderly Chinese shopkeeper with crystal magnifier glasses, grizzled beard, calm wise expression
掌柜.look: an elderly Chinese man in his sixties, sparse grizzled beard, deep nasolabial folds, wearing round crystal magnifier glasses, thin pale lips, calm unreadable expression, dark brown padded jacket, ink-stained fingers, standing behind a wooden counter with hundred-eye medicine cabinets behind

bio.personality: 表面和气迟缓，实则眼毒；说话留半句
bio.backstory: 守着祖上传下的药铺，认得叶玄机师门的旧物
bio.costume: 深褐夹袄，袖口沾墨，戴水晶老花镜
bio.habits: 说话前先研两圈墨；抬眼时才真正看人
bio.voice_style: 沙哑偏慢，尾音略沉，压低声音时最危险

司马谷岩.anchor: a burly brutal Chinese man with heavy beard, coarse linen robe, savage grin
司马谷岩.look: a burly brutal Chinese man in his forties, heavy black beard, thick brows, broad shoulders, coarse linen robe open at the chest, scar across the left cheek, savage grin showing teeth, thick fingers gripping a broad saber

bio.personality: 嚣张、轻敌、得势便忘形，受挫后暴怒
bio.backstory: 占山为王，靠一把刀在边境混了十几年
bio.costume: 粗麻短褐，敞胸，左颊一道旧疤
bio.habits: 说话时刀尖不自觉地挑动；笑起来先咧嘴再出声
bio.voice_style: 粗哑、音量大、语调上扬，发怒时咬字极重
